Create web/src/components/Header.tsx and Header.css.

Header.tsx: functional component with prop { connected: boolean }. Renders a fixed-height bar with 'engin' as bold text logo on the left (color: var(--engin-accent), 18px), and a small colored dot on the right (8px circle, green if connected, red if not). Import './Header.css'.

Header.css:
.header { height: var(--engin-header-height); background: var(--engin-bg-secondary); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--engin-border); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 var(--engin-space-md); flex-shrink: 0; }
.logo { font-weight: 700; color: var(--engin-accent); font-size: 18px; }
.connection-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; }
